name: A Pony
description: Passively grants flight and increases speed to 1.5. Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving invulnerability during the charge and dealing damage to enemies hit.

name: Anarchist Cookbook
description: Spawns six Troll Bombs around the room.

name: Best Friend
description: Spawns a decoy Isaac that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies will always target the decoy and ignore Isaac.

name: Blank Card
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Copies the effect of the card or rune currently held by Isaac. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the card.

name: Blood Rights
quote: Mass enemy damage at a cost
description: Takes a full heart of health and deals 40 damage to all enemies in the room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Repeated uses in the same room only take half a heart. (in Repentance+) Increases fire rate when used.

name: Bob's Rotten Head
description: Isaac holds a poison Bomb which can be thrown in a cardinal direction and explodes on impact.

name: Book of Revelations
description: Increases the chance of a Devil Room / Angel Room appearing while held. Upon use, gives one Soul Heart, and replaces the boss of the current floor with a Harbinger if possible.

name: Book of Secrets
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+)?????? (in Repentance and Repentance+) Tome of knowledge
description: Gives the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor. (in Repentance and Repentance+) If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with Crawl Space in the room.

name: Book of Shadows
description: Creates a protective shield, nullifying all types of damage in the current room for 10 seconds.

name: Box of Spiders
description: Spawns (except in Repentance and Repentance+) 1-4 / (in Repentance and Repentance+) 4-8 Blue Spiders where Isaac is standing.

name: Breath of Life
description: Grants a brief moment of invincibility when the charge bar hits zero. Isaac begins taking damage if the item is held any longer. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Isaac creates beams of light when touching enemies while invulnerable, and creates a powerful 4-way beam if blocking damage exactly as the invincibility starts.

name: Butter Bean
description: Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies (except in Rebirth) and projectiles. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.

name: Converter
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Converts two Soul Hearts or Black Hearts into one filled Red Heart Container. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Converts one Soul Heart or Black Heart into one filled Red Heart Container.

name: Crack the Sky
description: Creates five beams of light around the room, dealing high damage to any enemies that touch them.

name: Crystal Ball
description: Reveals the map (except the Super Secret Room and (in Repentance and Repentance+) Ultra Secret Room) and drops a Soul Heart or random card or rune. (in Repentance and Repentance+) While held, increases the chance of finding a Planetarium.

name: D10
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Rerolls all monsters in the room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters.

name: D100
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Activates the combined effects of D4, The D6, and D20. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Activates the combined effects of D1, D4, The D6, D7, D8, D10, D12, and D20.

name: D20
description: Re-rolls all pickups, chests, and trinkets in the current room.

name: D4
description: Rerolls all of Isaac's passive items.

name: Dad's Key
description: Opens all doors in the current room in almost all circumstances, including doors which require a Key to open, entrances to Secret Rooms, and the door to Mega Satan.

name: Dead Sea Scrolls
description: Triggers the effect of a random activated item from a list of possible options (not every activated item is included).

name: Deck of Cards
description: Gives Isaac a random card.

name: Doctor's Remote
description: Creates a crosshair on the ground that can be aimed with tear controls. A missile strikes the spot after 2 seconds, creating a heavy damage explosion.

name: Flush!
description: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop. (except in Rebirth) Instantly kills poop-themed bosses. Floods the current room.

name: Forget Me Now
description: Restarts the current floor with a new layout. Any items and pickups from the original floor are kept.

name: Guppy's Head
description: Spawns 2-4 friendly Blue Flies that damage enemies.

name: Guppy's Paw
description: Converts one Red Heart Container into three Soul Hearts.

name: Head of Krampus
description: Fires a powerful Brimstone beam in four cardinal directions. (in Afterbirth) Has a 50% chance to rotate all beams around Isaac 90 degrees.

name: How to Jump
description: Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving, allowing travel over obstacles and enemies.

name: Isaac's Tears
description: Fires 8 tears around Isaac, which use his damage, range, shot speed, and tear effects. Shooting charges this item. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Tears from this item have a +5 flat damage.

name: IV Bag
description: Damages Isaac and spawns a random amount of coins, similar to a Blood Donation Machine.

name: Kamikaze!
description: Creates an explosion around Isaac, damaging him and nearby enemies as well as destroying obstacles.

name: Lemon Mishap
description: Creates a small pool of yellow creep, damaging enemies that cross it. (in Repentance+) The pool lasts for the entire room.

name: Magic Fingers
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Pay to play (in Repentance and Repentance+) Pay to win
description: Consumes one Penny to deal damage to all enemies in the room.

name: Mom's Bottle of Pills
description: Gives Isaac a random pill.

name: Mom's Bra
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Mass Fear (in Repentance and Repentance+) Mass paralysis
description: Petrifies all enemies in the current room for 4 seconds.

name: Mom's Pad
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Gross... (in Repentance and Repentance+) Mass fear
description: Inflicts fear to all enemies in the room for 4 seconds. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Spawns a blue fly.

name: Monster Manual
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Spawns a familiar from a specific selection for the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Spawns a familiar from a specific selection for the current floor.

name: Monstro's Tooth
description: A friendly Monstro jumps on a random enemy, dealing 120 damage in an area. Targets Isaac if used in a room without enemies.

name: Mr. Boom
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Places a Mr. Mega Bomb that deals 110 damage. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Places a Mr. Mega Bomb that deals 185 damage.

name: My Little Unicorn
description: Grants invulnerability and +0.28 speed for six seconds, removing the ability to shoot tears and replacing it with the ability to deal contact damage to enemies.

name: Notched Axe
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Isaac destroys obstacles and opens Secret Rooms by walking into them, but cannot shoot or pick up items until it's cancelled. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Toggles between tears and the pickaxe, which can be swung to attack and break obstacles. Using it depletes the charge, and it can't be used until next floor once the charge runs out.

name: Pandora's Box
description: Spawns specific pickups or items depending on the floor it is used on. Disappears after use.

name: Portable Slot
description: Consumes one Penny and has a chance to drop a random pickup, like a Slot Machine.

name: Prayer Card
description: Gives Isaac an Eternal Heart.

name: Razor Blade
description: Damages Isaac for one heart and grants +1.2 damage for the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Subsequent uses in the same room only take half a heart.

name: Red Candle
description: Throws out a flame that damages everything in its path, diminishing in size as it hits enemies or blocks shots.

name: Remote Detonator
description: Bombs placed by Isaac only explode when Remote Detonator is used. Gives 5 bombs.

name: Satanic Bible
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Reusable evil (in Repentance and Repentance+) Reusable evil... but at what cost?
description: Grants one Black Heart. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Replaces the boss room item on the current floor with a Devil Deal.

name: Scissors
description: Turns Isaac's head into a stationary familiar for the current room which fires tears automatically. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Isaac's body also shoots a controllable fountain of blood shots for the room.

name: Shoop da Whoop!
description: Fires a laser from Isaac's mouth that deals twice Isaac's tear damage.

name: Spider Butt
description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies in the room and slows them for 4 seconds. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Enemies killed by Spider Butt spawn Blue Spiders.

name: Tammy's Head
description: Shoots 10 tears in a circle around Isaac, which retain the damage, range, shot speed, and special effects (such as poison) of Isaac's tears. Tears from this item have a +25 flat damage bonus.

name: Telepathy For Dummies
description: Gives homing tears for the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Also gives +3 range.

name: Teleport!
description: Teleports Isaac to a random room on the current floor, except for I AM ERROR rooms.

name: The Bean
description: Isaac farts, damaging and poisoning any enemy in close range.

name: The Bible
description: Grants flight for the current room. Instantly kills Mom, Mom's Heart, and It Lives! when activated, but kills Isaac when used on Satan.

name: The Book of Belial
description: (in Rebirth) +2 damage for the current room. Passively guarantees a Devil Room or Angel Room will appear while held. (except in Rebirth) +2 damage for the current room. Passively increases the chance of finding a Devil Room or Angel Room while held.

name: The Book of Sin
description: Spawns a random coin, heart, bomb, key, battery, pill or card near Isaac.

name: The Boomerang
description: Throws a boomerang which retrieves pickups, as well as damages and petrifies enemies hit for 2 seconds. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Pierces through enemies.

name: The Candle
description: Throws out a blue flame that damages everything in its path, diminishing in size as it travels.

name: The D6
description: Re-rolls all items in the current room into other items, depending on the current room's item pool.

name: The Gamekid
description: Transforms Isaac into a rainbow-colored chomping creature for 6.5 seconds. Grants invulnerability, inflicts fear on all enemies, and has a chance of replenishing a Half Red Heart every time an enemy is killed.

name: The Hourglass
description: All enemies in the room are slowed for 8 seconds.

name: The Jar
description: When at full health, up to 4 extra Red Hearts can be stored in The Jar. Activating drops the stored hearts on the ground.

name: The Nail
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Gives one Soul Heart. For the current room; +0.7 damage, -0.18 speed, Isaac breaks rocks and deals contact damage. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Gives half a Black Heart. For the current room; +2 damage, -0.18 speed, Isaac breaks rocks and deals contact damage.

name: The Necronomicon
description: Deals 40 damage to every enemy in the room.

name: The Pinking Shears
description: Separates Isaac's head from his body for the current room, granting flight and turning the body into a familiar that chases enemies.

name: The Poop
description: Spawns a pile of Poop where Isaac is standing and knocks back nearby enemies. It may yield pickups like regular poop.

name: Undefined
description: Teleports Isaac to the Secret Room, Super Secret Room, Treasure Room, or I AM ERROR.

name: Unicorn Stump
description: Gives invulnerability and increased speed for six seconds, but removes the ability to shoot tears.

name: We Need To Go Deeper!
description: Creates a trapdoor to go to the next floor. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Once per floor, using it on tiles with special graphics will instead create a Crawl Space.

name: White Pony
description: Passively grants flight and increases speed to 1.5. Upon use, Isaac charges in the direction the pony is facing, giving invulnerability during the charge while also creating damaging beams of light.

name: Yum Heart
description: Restores one full Red Heart.

name: Box of Friends
description: Duplicates all of Isaac's familiars for the current room. If Isaac has no familiars, spawns a Demon Baby for the room instead.

name: D12
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Re-rolls all Rocks and Metal Blocks in the current room into other random obstacles. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Re-rolls most types of obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.

name: D7
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Reroll Rewards! (in Repentance and Repentance+) Roll again
description: Restarts the current room and respawns all monsters, allowing more rewards to be acquired by completing the room.

name: D8
description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.

name: Diplopia
description: Duplicates all pickups and item pedestals in the current room.

name: Friendly Ball
description: Throwing the ball at a monster instantly kills and captures it. The captured enemy can later be released and will be friendly, fighting for Isaac and persisting between rooms.

name: Glass Cannon
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Fires a high-damage piercing spectral tear, but lowers Isaac's health to half a heart. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Fires a high-damage piercing spectral tear. If Isaac takes damage while holding this, he takes extra damage and it becomes Broken Glass Cannon.

name: Glowing Hourglass
description: Rewinds time, putting Isaac back in the previous room and undoing anything that happened in the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Can only be used three times per floor, after which it functions like The Hourglass until the next floor.

name: Jar of Flies
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Gotta catch 'em all? (in Repentance and Repentance+) Bug catcher
description: Killing an enemy adds a fly to the jar, up to a maximum of 20. On use, releases Blue Flies equal to the number of flies in the jar.

name: Kidney Bean
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Love toots! (in Repentance and Repentance+) Love toots
description: Isaac farts, charming all nearby enemies.

name: Mega Bean
description: Petrifies all enemies in the current room for about 1.5 seconds, poisons any enemies near Isaac. (except in Repentance+) The fart also sends a rock wave across the room in the direction Isaac is facing. (in Repentance+) The fart also creates a Mama Mega! explosion.

name: Mega Blast
description: Isaac fires a giant blood laser for approximately 15 seconds. This laser deals massive damage, pushes Isaac backwards, and persists between rooms and floors.

name: Mine Crafter
description: Places a Movable TNT barrel that can be pushed and used to destroy rocks or damage enemies. If used again in the same room while the previous TNT barrel is still intact, remotely detonates the TNT.

name: Mom's Box
quote: (in Rebirth and Afterbirth) Whats inside? (except in Rebirth and Afterbirth) What's inside?
description: Increases luck by 1 and doubles the effects of trinkets while held. When used, drops a random trinket on the ground.

name: Placebo
description: Copies the effect of the pill currently held by Isaac. (in Repentance and Repentance+) The recharge time is based on the power of the pill.

name: Tear Detonator
description: Splits all of Isaac's tears that are currently in the air into 6 tears that fire in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.

name: Teleport 2.0
description: Teleports Isaac to a room that has not been explored yet. Normal rooms are prioritized over special rooms, and common special rooms take priority over rarer ones.

name: Ventricle Razor
description: Creates up to two portals that remain even if Isaac leaves the room. Upon entering a portal, Isaac is teleported to the other portal.

name: Wooden Nickel
description: Has a roughly 50% chance to drop a Penny, Nickel, or Dime and a roughly 50% chance to do nothing.

name: Black Hole
description: Throws a black hole on the ground which sucks in and damages enemies and destroys nearby obstacles.

name: Book of the Dead
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Creates a friendly Bony, Black Bony, Bone Fly, Revenant, Big Bony, or an orbital bone for each enemy killed in the current room.

name: Broken Shovel
description: While held, causes Mom to continuously attempt to stomp on Isaac. Activating makes her stop for the current room or wave. One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel.

name: Brown Nugget
description: Spawns a stationary fly turret that lasts for the current room and fires tears at nearby enemies.

name: Clicker
description: Transforms Isaac into another random character and has (except in Repentance+) 100% / (in Repentance and Repentance+) 50% chance to remove the last item collected.

name: Compost
description: Doubles Isaac's Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, or spawns one if Isaac has none. Converts pickups in the current room into Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.

name: Coupon
description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale for half price. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.

name: Crooked Penny
description: Has a 50% chance to double all items, chests, trinkets, and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, spawns a Penny and the other items and pickups disappear.

name: D infinity
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Has the effect of a random die item that changes each use. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Replicates the effect of a selected die item (except Spindown Dice), and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.

name: D1
description: Duplicates a random pickup in the room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) The new pickup may be different than the original (i.e. a different card, etc).

name: Dataminer
description: Displaces enemy sprites for the current room and randomly increases one of Isaac's stats while decreasing another. (in Repentance+) Turns all items in the room into glitched items with random effects.

name: Delirious
description: Spawns Delirium as a random friendly boss that fights for Isaac. (except in Repentance+) The boss lasts the for the current room. (in Repentance+) The boss persists between rooms. The charge time is based on the power of the boss summoned.

name: Dull Razor
description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.

name: Eden's Soul
description: Spawns two random items from the current room's Item Pool and then disappears. Starts with no charges.

name: Mama Mega!
description: Deals immense damage to all enemies, opens all bombable doors, and destroys all obstacles in the room. The effect occurs every time a new room is entered for the rest of the floor.

name: Metronome
description: Grants a random item effect for the current room.

name: Mom's Shovel
description: Creates a trapdoor that leads to the next floor. Unlocks The Forgotten when used on a mound of dirt that appears in Dark Room.

name: Moving Box
description: If the box is empty, picks up items and pickups in a room and stores them. If the box is not empty, places all stored items and pickups in the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Can carry up to 10 items or pickups at once.

name: Mr. ME!
description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.

name: Mystery Gift
description: Spawns a random item from the current room's item pool, with a chance to spawn A Lump of Coal or The Poop instead.

name: Pause
description: Freezes all enemies until a fire button is pressed.

name: Plan C
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Use with caution (in Repentance and Repentance+) My last resort
description: Kills all enemies in the room, then kills Isaac three seconds later.

name: Potato Peeler
description: Removes a Heart Container, increases Damage and Range, and grants a Cube of Meat. (in Repentance+) If Isaac has a Ball of Bandages, it will instead give additional copies of that.

name: Sacrificial Altar
description: Sacrifices up to two familiars and spawns an item pedestal for each familiar sacrificed. Converts all friendly spiders and flies into coins.

name: Sharp Straw
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart or Half Soul Heart if an enemy is hit. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Damages all enemies in the room. Has a chance to drop a Half Red Heart if an enemy is hit.

name: Smelter
description: Consumes Isaac's currently held trinket and applies its effects permanently.

name: Sprinkler
description: Creates a stationary sprinkler for the current room that rotates and fires tears in 8 directions. The tears copy Isaac's stats and most tear effects.

name: Telekinesis
description: Any enemy shots that come near Isaac for the next three seconds are held in place then fired back.

name: Void
description: Consumes all pedestal items in the room. Activated items will have their effects added to Void, and passive items will grant random stat upgrades.

name: Wait What?
quote: I can't believe it's not butter bean!
description: Isaac farts, sending out a circular rock wave that destroys obstacles and hurts enemies.

name: Abyss
description: Destroys all item pedestals in the room and gives Isaac a unique locust familiar for each item destroyed. Locusts fly forwards in the direction Isaac shoots and damage enemies hit. Destroying certain items spawns special locusts with unique effects.

name: Alabaster Box
description: Upon use, spawns three Soul Hearts and two Angel Room items and is consumed. Starts with no charges, and can only be charged by picking up 6 Soul Hearts.

name: Anima Sola
description: Chains down the nearest enemy for 5 seconds, preventing them from moving or attacking.

name: Bag of Crafting
description: Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.

name: Berserk!
description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.

name: Book of Virtues
description: Passively causes active items to spawn themed orbital wisp familiars on use, which fire tears and block shots. Can be activated to spawn a basic wisp if Isaac has no other active item.

name: Broken Glass Cannon
description: Begins with no charges and turns into Glass Cannon when used. Only acquired by taking damage while holding Glass Cannon.

name: Clear Rune
description: Copies the effect of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the rune. Drops a random rune when first picked up.

name: Damocles
quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.

name: Dark Arts
description: Briefly grants +1 speed and makes Isaac invulnerable and intangible. When the effect ends, destroys all projectiles and damages all enemies Isaac passed through.

name: Death Certificate
description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.

name: Decap Attack
description: Throws Isaac's head, which is still able to fire tears at the spot it lands. Reactivating the item or stepping on the head reattaches it.

name: Eraser
description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.

name: Esau Jr.
description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.

name: Eternal D6
description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.

name: Everything Jar
description: Spawns certain pickups based on how many charges it has. If fully charged, instead has one of many unique effects.

name: Flip
description: Item pedestals have a second un-interactable "ghostly" item behind them. Activating will flip the real and ghostly items around. If playing as Tainted Lazarus, also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.

name: Fortune Cookie
description: Gives Isaac a fortune, Soul Heart, Card, Rune, or trinket, similar to a Fortune Telling Machine. Fortunes are much more likely to be given than anything else.

name: Free Lemonade
description: Creates a large pool of yellow creep beneath Isaac.

name: Friend Finder
description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.

name: Gello
description: Spawns a demon familiar for the current room attached to Isaac that moves and fires in the direction Isaac shoots, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.

name: Genesis
description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique Clean Bedroom with some pickups and Chests and a passage to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.

name: Golden Razor
description: Spends 5 pennies to grant +1.2 damage for the current room. Grants 5 pennies when picked up for the first time.

name: Hold
description: Exclusive to Tainted???. Allows him to save one poop bomb for later, allowing him to gather more over time.

name: Jar of Wisps
description: Spawns random wisps that shoot various tears, block shots, and deal contact damage. The number of wisps spawned increases every time the jar is used.

name: Keeper's Box
description: Spawns a random Shop item or pickup which can be bought for its normal price.

name: Larynx
description: Isaac shouts, damaging and pushing away nearby enemies. The shout gets stronger the more charges the item has. Larynx gains 1 charge whenever Isaac takes damage, in addition to charging normally.

name: Lemegeton
description: Spawns a destructible orbital familiar representing a random passive item, which blocks shots and deals contact damage. While the wisp is alive, Isaac gains that item's effects.

name: Magic Skin
description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.

name: Meat Cleaver
description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.

name: Mega Mush
description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.

name: Mom's Bracelet
description: Lets Isaac pick up and throw rocks, TNT, Poops, friendly Dips, Bombs, and other obstacles.

name: Plum Flute
description: Summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac for roughly 10 seconds, dealing high damage.

name: R Key
description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.

name: Recall
description: Retrieves the Forgotten's body from any distance. Only available as the Birthright effect for Tainted Forgotten.

name: Red Key
description: Creates a Red Room adjacent to a viable wall, indicated by the outline of a door. These rooms have a 10% chance to be a special room.

name: Sharp Key
description: Adds 5 Keys on pickup. Allows Isaac to throw his keys to deal damage to enemies, destroy obstacles, and open doors.

name: Spin to Win
description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.

name: Spindown Dice
description: Reduces the internal ID number of all items in the room by one, turning them into the item with that number.

name: Stitches
description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.

name: Sulfur
description: Grants Brimstone for the current room.

name: Sumptorium
description: Removes half a heart and creates a Clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tear effects. As Tainted Eve, passively converts health into Clots while firing. Activating returns all Clots to health.

name: Suplex!
description: Isaac dashes forward and picks up the first enemy hit. After a moment, he jumps and slams them into the ground to deal damage and create a circular rock wave.

name: The Scooper
description: Summons The Peeper for the current room, which leaves a trail of red creep.

name: Urn of Souls
description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.

name: Vade Retro
description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.

name: Wavy Cap
quote: Tears up. A mind changing experience!
description: Increases tears, decreases speed, and distorts the screen. All effects become more pronounced with repeated use, and wear off by clearing rooms.

name: Yuck Heart
description: Grants Isaac a Rotten Heart.

name: ???'s Only Friend
description: Spawns a controllable familiar that deals (except in Repentance and Repentance+) 37.5 / (in Repentance and Repentance+) 15 damage per second on touch. It can be moved using the shooting directional keys
Grants Isaac one Red Heart container and fully restores Isaac's health.

name: 1up!
description: Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, he will respawn in the previous room with full health, after which 1up! will disappear.
Isaac fires two tears at once, one from each eye. (in Repentance and Repentance+) 0.8× damage multiplier.

name: 3 Dollar Bill
description: (in Rebirth) Gives Isaac a random tear effect every room. (except in Rebirth) Gives Isaac a random tear effect every few seconds.

name: 9 Volt
description: Reduces the charge of any activated item by 1. Any 1 charge items instead have timed recharges.

name: A Dollar
description: Gives Isaac 100 Pennies.

name: A Lump of Coal
description: The more distance tears travel, the more damage they will do.

name: A Quarter
description: Gives Isaac 25 coins.

name: A Snack

description: Spawns a familiar that fires lasers at any enemy in its line of sight and moves based on the direction Isaac is firing tears.

name: Roid Rage
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) +0.6 speed, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +0.3 speed, +2.5 range

name: Rosary
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Faith up (in Repentance and Repentance+) Tears + faith up
description: Grants 3 Soul Hearts. The Bible has a chance to appear in any item pool. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +0.5 tears.

name: Rotten Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that spawns a Blue Fly when Isaac shoots. It can only have one Fly at a time.

description: Grants one full Red Heart container. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

description: Tears bounce off walls, enemies, and environmental objects.

name: Sack of Pennies
description: Spawns a familiar that drops a coin every 2 rooms.

name: Sacred Heart

description: Spawns a dagger orbital familiar, blocking enemy shots and dealing a high amount of damage to enemies in contact.

name: Sad Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Upon exploding, bombs shoot 10 tears around them, affected by tear modifiers.

name: Safety Pin
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants one Black Heart, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed, +0.16 shot speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants one Black Heart, +2.5 range, +0.16 shot speed.

name: Sagittarius
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Penetrative shot + speed up (in Repentance and Repentance+) Piercing shots + speed up
description: Increases speed by +0.2 and grants piercing tears.

name: Samson's Chains
description: Attaches a ball and chain to Isaac that pulls behind him that damages enemies, blocks shots, and destroys most Obstacles.

name: Scapular
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) You have been blessed (in Repentance and Repentance+) Pray for a miracle
description: Once per room, when Isaac is reduced to his last half heart, he is granted one Soul Heart.

name: Scorpio
description: Grants poison tears, which deal damage over time when inflicted.

name: Screw
description: +0.5 tears, +0.2 shot speed.

name: Sharp Plug
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Charge with blood (in Repentance and Repentance+) Infinite charge... at a cost
description: Damages Isaac in exchange for fully recharging Isaac's current activated item.

name: Sissy Longlegs
description: Spawns a familiar that wanders randomly, occasionally spawning Blue Spiders. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Briefly charms enemies on contact.

name: Sister Maggy
description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears (except in Repentance and Repentance+) once per second that each do 3.5 damage / (in Repentance and Repentance+) 1.36 times per second that each do 6 damage.

name: Skatole
description: Flies become harmless or less dangerous depending on the type.

name: Skeleton Key
description: Gives Isaac 99 Keys.

name: Smart Fly
description: Spawns an orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots. Upon taking damage, the familiar will pursue enemies for the rest of the room, dealing damage.

name: SMB Super Fan
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) +1 Red Heart container, +0.3 damage, +0.2 tears, +0.2 speed, +0.5 range, +1 tear falling speed. Fully restores all red hearts. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +1 Red Heart container, +0.3 damage, +0.2 tears, +0.2 speed, +2.5 range. Fully restores all red hearts.

name: Soy Milk
description: Tears are smaller and do much less damage, but fire in very rapid succession.

name: Speed Ball
description: +0.3 speed, +0.2 shot speed.

name: Spelunker Hat
description: Reveals type of adjacent rooms, including location for Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Reveals rooms up to 2 rooms away and blocks projectiles falling from above.

name: Spider Bite
description: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing speed of enemy movement and any projectile fired by them.

name: Spiderbaby
description: Spawns (except in Repentance and Repentance+) 1-2 / (in Repentance and Repentance+) 3-5 Blue Spiders when Isaac takes damage.

name: Spirit of the Night
description: Grants spectral tears and flight.

name: Spoon Bender
description: Grants Isaac homing tears.

name: Squeezy
description: +0.4 tears, spawns 2 Soul Hearts.

name: Starter Deck
description: Isaac can hold 2 cards at once and all pills are replaced by cards.

name: Steam Sale
description: Reduces all Shop prices by 50%, rounded down to 7 coins for an item, rounded up to 2-3 coins for a pickup.

name: Stem Cells
description: Grants one full Red Heart container and +0.16 shot speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Heals 1 additional Red Heart

name: Steven
description: +1 damage.

name: Stigmata
description: +0.3 damage, grants one full Red Heart container. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

name: Stop Watch
quote: Let's slow this down a bit...
description: (in Rebirth) +0.3 speed. Automatically inflicts slow to all enemies in every room. (in Afterbirth and Afterbirth †) +0.3 speed. Upon taking damage, inflicts slow to all enemies for the current room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +0.3 speed. Slows all enemies in every room to 80% speed.

name: Strange Attractor
description: Pickups, trinkets, and monsters are magnetically attracted to Isaac's tears.

name: Super Bandage
description: Grants one full Red Heart container and 2 Soul Hearts.

name: Synthoil
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) +1 damage, +5.25 range, +0.5 tear falling speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +1 damage, +2.5 range.

name: Taurus
description: -0.3 Speed. Isaac builds speed while in a room with enemies. At max speed, he gains the My Little Unicorn effect for 5 seconds.

name: Tech.5
description: Isaac occasionally fires an unlimited range piercing laser alongside his normal tears. The laser can glitch, mimicking the effects of certain items and trinkets.

name: Technology
description: Replaces tears with a piercing laser with unlimited range.

name: Technology 2
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Laser (in Repentance and Repentance+) Extra laser
description: Replaces the tears fired from Isaac's right eye with a rapid-firing low damage piercing laser. (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Damage down.

name: The Battery
description: Activated items can be overcharged, allowing them to store up to one extra use.

name: The Belt
description: +0.3 speed.

name: The Black Bean
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) When taking damage, Isaac farts, poisoning enemies in range. (in Repentance and Repentance+) When taking damage, Isaac farts five times, poisoning and knocking back nearby enemies and leaving lingering poison clouds.

name: The Body
description: Adds 3 Red Heart Containers.

name: The Common Cold
description: Adds a chance to shoot poison tears, dealing damage over time when inflicted.

name: The Compass
description: Reveals the locations and types of all special rooms on the map, except Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms.

name: The Halo
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants one full Red Heart container, +0.3 damage, +0.2 tears, +0.25 range, +0.3 speed, and +0.5 tear falling speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants one full Red Heart container, +0.3 damage, +0.2 tears, +1.5 range, and +0.3 speed. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

name: The Inner Eye
description: Isaac shoots three tears at once with lower fire rate.

name: The Ladder
description: Allows Isaac to walk across gaps one square across by automatically placing a ladder between the two walkable sections.

name: The Ludovico Technique
description: Instead of firing tears, Isaac controls one floating tear that hover over obstacles. This tear deals constant damage when held in place over an enemy.

name: The Mark
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) DMG up (in Repentance and Repentance+) DMG + speed up
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants one Soul Heart, +1 damage, and +0.2 speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants one Black Heart, +1 damage, and +0.2 speed.

name: The Mind
description: Reveals the entire map, including all special rooms and Secret Rooms.

name: The Mulligan
description: Tears have a 16.67% chance of spawning allied Blue Flies when they hit an enemy.

name: The Negative
description: If Isaac has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, all enemies in the room take significant damage. Allows entrance into the Dark Room. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +1 Damage and also allows access to Home.

name: The Pact
description: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants two Soul Hearts, +0.5 damage, and +0.7 tears. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Grants two Black Hearts, +0.5 damage, and +0.7 tears.

name: The Parasite
description: Isaac's tears split in two when they hit something.

name: The Peeper
description: Spawns a familiar that slowly floats around the room in a zig-zag pattern, damaging enemies it passes through. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Increases the damage of tears from Isaac's left eye by 35%.

name: The Polaroid
description: If Isaac has half a red heart or no red hearts after taking damage, he gains a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 5 seconds. Allows entrance into Chest. (in Repentance and Repentance+) Also allows access to Home.

name: The Relic
description: Spawns a cross familiar that drops a Soul Heart after clearing enough rooms.

name: The Sad Onion
description: +0.7 tears.

name: The Small Rock
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) DMG up (in Repentance and Repentance+) DMG up + speed down
description: +1 damage, +0.2 tears, -0.2 speed.

name: The Soul
description: Grants two Soul Hearts. Isaac gains a pulsing aura that repels enemies and projectiles.

name: The Virus
quote: (except in Repentance and Repentance+) Poison touch (in Repentance and Repentance+) Poison touch + speed up
description: Isaac poisons enemies on contact. (except in Repentance and Repentance+) -0.1 speed. (in Repentance and Repentance+) +0.2 speed. (in Afterbirth and Afterbirth †) Poisoned enemies have a chance to drop a black heart when killed.

name: The Wafer
description: Most sources of damage that would cause more than one-half heart of damage are reduced to one-half heart instead.

name: There's Options
description: Two items appear after defeating a Boss. Only one can be taken; the other will disappear.

name: Thunder Thighs
quote: HP up + speed down + you feel stompy
description: Destroys rocks upon contact with Isaac. Adds one Red Heart container and lowers Speed.

name: Tiny Planet
description: Massively increases Range and grants spectral tears. Tears orbit around Isaac at a fixed distance until they hit the ground.

name: Tooth Picks
description: +0.7 tears, +0.16 shot speed.

name: Torn Photo
description: +0.7 tears, +0.16 shot speed.

name: Tough Love
description: Adds a chance to shoot a tooth instead of a tear, which deals x3.2 Isaac's damage.

name: Transcendence
description: Grants flight.

name: Treasure Map
description: Reveals the map of each floor. It does not identify special rooms and does not reveal the locations of Secret Rooms / Super Secret Rooms.

name: Trinity Shield
description: Isaac gains a shield that protects him from enemy shots. It aims in the direction Isaac fires from.

name: Virgo
description: Adds a chance to give a shield that nullifies all incoming damage for 10 seconds upon taking damage. Also converts bad pills into good pills.

name: Whore of Babylon
description: Grants +1.5 Damage and +0.3 Speed whenever Isaac has a Half Red Heart or less.

name: Wire Coat Hanger
description: +0.7 tears.

name: Wooden Spoon
description: +0.3 speed.

name: X-Ray Vision
description: Reveals and opens all Secret Room and Super Secret Room entrances.
